subject: Capacity onramp, usage debrief and term scenario planning
messages:
From: Eva Morales <eva@astratech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Baker <tim@astratech.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync - renewal capacity & onramp questions

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well. We’re starting internal planning for our June renewal and there are three items I want to understand before we meet: 1) our current token mix and how that maps to the Dedicated uplift you proposed; 2) any latency regressions you’ve seen since we moved the model to quantized parity; and 3) a clear outline of ramp windows (how quickly we can add burst units).

Numbers for context (May): 1.5B generation tokens (30% chat, 70% batch), 12M embeddings. Peak QPS targets for July expected to be ~65 rps (avg 22 rps). We’re evaluating a 2x capacity jump but want to avoid a long lead time.

Can you send a short usage report + ops snapshot and propose two times for a 30-min meeting this week? Also, Tim asked whether we can get a pricing scenario that compares a 6‑month term vs a 12‑month term for the uplift.

Thanks,
Eva
Eva Morales
Head of Product, AstraTech

Attachments: astratech_po_may23.pdf (stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Eva Morales <eva@astratech.com>
Cc: Tim Baker <tim@astratech.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick sync - renewal capacity & onramp questions

Hi Eva — great timing. Thanks for the context. I’ve pulled together a compact usage snapshot and an ops latency brief (attached). Quick answers up front:

- Token mix: your generation/embedding split lines up with our observed billing. We show 1.47B gen / 11.9M embed for May on your org id.
- Quantized parity: no systemic latency regressions in the last 30 days; transient 95th percentile spikes related to a single model variant which we mitigated with a routing rule on 2028-05-18.
- Burst/onramp: we can provision burst capacity within 48–72 hours for an additional 2x on top of your baseline, and we can shorten to 24 hours with an upfront short-term burst credit commitment.

I attached: usage_report_may2028.csv and ops_latency_snapshot.pdf. For pricing scenarios I’ve asked Karthik to draft two term scenarios (6m vs 12m) with a staged-added capacity ladder and projected token unit economics.

Proposed times for a 30-min sync: Thu 2028-05-24 10:00am PT or Fri 2028-05-25 9:00am PT. Which works for you?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: usage_report_may2028.csv (stub), ops_latency_snapshot.pdf (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Morales <eva@astratech.com>, Tim Baker <tim@astratech.com>
Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 14:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick sync - renewal capacity & onramp questions

Soojin / Karthik — quick internal note before the call:

- I reviewed the usage CSV. The short window pattern shows two nightly batch windows that drive the 70% batch mix; we should propose a caching suggestion to reduce peak.
- Ops: the routing rule that removed the bad variant also improved 95th p95 tail by ~120ms on average — include that stat in the deck.
- Commercial ask: propose a 12-month staged commit with a mid-term true-up (90 days) and a 10% discount on the uplift tranche. If legal pushes back, have a fallback 6-month with a larger burst credit (one-time).

Action items for our call prep: Karthik, can you draft the two term scenarios + a short one-slide ROI that shows token cost delta with/without cache? I’ll build a one-page ops memo with the latency delta and recommended routing policy. Soojin — I’ll be on the call and will own the ops section.

Thanks — M.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — the attachments look good. We’ll take Fri 2028-05-25 9:00am PT for the 30-min call. A couple of follow-ups ahead of the meeting:

1) Can you include a short worked example in the 6‑month vs 12‑month scenario showing projected monthly cost at 1x, 1.5x and 2x consumption (token buckets)?
2) Legal requests: include the proposed term addendum as a doc we can circulate internally so they can pre-review. I’ve cc’d legal.

I’ve attached a brief PO for internal tracking, but the formal commitment will follow the term scenario we agree on. Looking forward to the call.

—Tim
Tim Baker
VP Engineering, AstraTech
